newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Paper sees current profit below forecast.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Paper sees current profit below forecast.

text.p: Nippon Paper Industries Co Ltd said on Tuesday that its parent current profit in the year to March 31, 1997, was likely to be less than its October forecast of 41 billion yen and that profits were expected to fall further in 1997/98.

"We cannot provide figures but our 1996/97 profit will be lower than our (earlier) outlook and it will further fall in the following year, partly due to falling paper prices," a Nippon Paper spokesman said.

Japanese business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Tuesday that it thought Nippon Paper's parent current profit would fall to 20 billion yen in 1997/98, down 46 percent from its estimate of the paper maker's profit in 1996/97.
Nihon Keizai did not mention an exact figure for the firm's estimated parent current profit for 1996/97.
The Nippon Paper spokesman said the newspaper report was not based on any company announcement.
